structuralFindings: Base plan is Bed & Breakfast (B&B), with optional Half Board (+$40pp/night) and Full Board (+$60pp/night) meal supplements — a different base plan from every Soroi property (Full Board base) and from Soroi Blue (Half Board base).

Two price columns per season: 'B&B RACK' and 'B&B NET' — B&B NET is consistently lower (roughly 15-20% below Rack), functioning like a built-in trade/agent discount rather than the STO-percentage-off-rack ladder seen in the Soroi documents. The exact discount percentage is not stated as a round STO tier number on the page itself (varies ~14.8%-17.3% by season) — do not assume it maps to any specific STO% band without further confirmation.
Three named seasons (High/Regular/Low) rather than Peak/Shoulder/Green.
Rate is quoted per person sharing in Double/Twin/Triple room — three occupancy types share one rate line, not broken out separately.
Single occupancy is a multiplier (x1.6) on the per-person rate, not a flat single supplement percentage.
